items: PMKSY — 10 years completed; outlay (2021-26) ₹93,068.56 Cr; new sub-scheme M-CADWM (₹1,600 Cr).
DWEEPTI Yojana — Chhattisgarh — 1st state with women-led distributed renewable energy policy. 🎯 🔥 HIGH.
PM-AJAY — Adarsh Gram Component — 47,328 villages selected.
ADB loans for India infra — $850 mn (PMSGMBY reforms — cross-refs PM Surya Ghar above) + $1 bn (Urban Transformation Program) — don't confuse the two purposes.
KCC-MISS impact assessment (ISEC study) — every ₹1 invested generates ₹2.30 net value addition.
National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM) — ₹292 Cr spent (of ₹19,744 Cr outlay).
MoIB approves "BIND" scheme extension for Prasar Bharati — extended to Mar 31, 2027.
Palna Scheme — AWCC expansion — 3,130 AWCCs (up from 1,761).
SMILE-Beggary Scheme expansion — operational in 216 cities (target 295 by FY31).
SC scholarship disbursement (3-yr data) — total ₹19,216.46 Cr.
